task.title: Format the JSON document
task.shortdesc: Format the current JSON document before review, validation, or handoff.

prereq.p: Open JSON editor with a JSON document in the editor.

context.p: Formatting changes whitespace and indentation only. It should make review easier without changing the policy meaning.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Review the resulting indentation and object layout.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Confirm no policy value changed during formatting.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Validate the document after formatting if you plan to save.

info.note: Saving raw JSON can change the canonical BPM profile. Validate syntax and policy values before saving.

result.p: The JSON document is easier to review and remains semantically unchanged.

postreq.p: Recovery: if formatting fails, fix JSON syntax first; trailing commas and missing braces are common causes.
